newsitem.title: USA: World Wireless in pact with Matsushita.
newsitem.headline: World Wireless in pact with Matsushita.

text.p: World Wireless Communications Inc said Monday its wholly owned subsidiary Digital Radio Communications Corp had signed a second agreement with Kyushu Matsushita Electric Co Ltd for the sale of wireless digital technology.
Kyushu Matsushita is a unit of Osaka-based Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd.
Under the agreement, the second in the past six months between the two companies, World Wireless will design proprietary digital technology for Kyushu, World Wireless said.
Terms of the pact were not disclosed.
